properties_definitions.note: Vega quantities are null when the Vega spectrum does not cover the curve.
properties_definitions.colors: DisplayColor is an sRGB hex for plotting (sed_tools.filter_colors). ColorMethod 'true': CIE D65 daylight seen through the curve, for bands with VisibleFraction (share of the throughput between 380 and 750 nm) of at least 0.5; 'false': ordered false colour for ultraviolet and infrared bands.
